description: This file implements a local filesystem interface with methods for file operations such as create, open, delete, directory management, and path handling, specifically for the 'filesys' package in the 'kustomize' project.

classes.name: fsOnDisk
classes.description: A struct implementing the FileSystem interface using the local OS filesystem.

methods.name: MakeFsOnDisk
methods.description: Factory function to create an instance of fsOnDisk.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new file with the specified name.

methods.name: Mkdir
methods.description: Creates a new directory with the specified name.

methods.name: MkdirAll
methods.description: Creates a directory and all necessary parents.

methods.name: RemoveAll
methods.description: Removes a file or directory and its contents.

methods.name: CleanedAbs
methods.description: Converts a path into an absolute, symlink-evaluated directory and filename.

methods.name: Exists
methods.description: Checks if a file or directory exists.

methods.name: Glob
methods.description: Returns files matching a pattern, filtering hidden files if applicable.

methods.name: IsDir
methods.description: Checks if a path is a directory.

methods.name: ReadFile
methods.description: Reads the contents of a file.

methods.name: WriteFile
methods.description: Writes data to a file with permissions 0666.

methods.name: Walk
methods.description: Walks the file tree rooted at a specified path.
